programs.description: Som's mother sees her son's selection for a singing reality show as a second chance to fulfil her own dreams. However, complications arise when he faces a quick defeat.
After the murder of millionaire Ranjit Rai, his mistress Radha is apprehended by the police. Journalist Rakesh teams up with his friends and a skilled defence lawyer to uncover the truth.

After returning to his village, Ravi learns that the local farmers are being oppressed by a despotic landlord. Soon, he decides to contest the panchayat elections against the tyrant and put an end to his cruel rule.

Rukhsar asks her best friend Nagma to marry her husband, Aslam, and mother a child for him when she is unable to do it herself. However, problems begin when Nagma's relatives cause discord among them.
A widowed woman's daughter elopes with her lover. Years later, when her granddaughter also falls in love, she strives to accept the relationship.
While filming a documentary in a prison, Chandrika comes across three unique stories and, somewhere in between, finds what her heart has been seeking.
Raj wishes to marry Rati but faces humiliation from her father due to the stigma associated with his lineage. Soon, he decides to join the police force to restore his family's honour.
A woman is held captive by a group of kidnappers to compel her MI5 husband to exterminate the prime minister of the country.
When Anoop ditches Mangala, she is forced to marry Anand, a blind singer. After seeing Anand's care, she falls for him, but things get complicated when Anoop re-enters the frame.
Rahul looks after his spoilt nephews, Sunny and Vicky, and niece, Munni. When they go to a funfair, they meet Vyjayanti, who has run away from home, and decide to shelter her without Rahul's consent.

Amit, the son of a taxi driver, and Reema, a rich businessman's daughter, fall in love. However, Reema's father wants to marry her to Vicky, whose father is the biggest gangster in Mumbai. How will their love triumph?

After losing his job owing to his arrogance and subsequently his son, Vijay, Atmaram realises his mistake and decides to turn over a new leaf.
A woman finds out her husband only married her to get revenge. However, she finds solace in her brother-in-law who helps her escape the abusive household.
A man, shocked by his father's decision to leave everything to a grandniece, engages a matrimonial agent to act as her husband in hopes of securing the family estate.
Rahul, an ordinary engineer, comes to Mathura with his wife and son. However, when a gangster gets attracted to his wife and forces her to marry him, he tries to find a way to stop his advances.
An idealist elder brother lands in a dilemma after he misplaces his little sister's shoes. Unable to afford a new pair, the siblings agree to share the shoes, leading to several escapades.
Mangal Singh escapes prison and begins a new life, unknowingly befriending his victim's family. As he seeks redemption, his past catches up, compelling him to confront his previous misdeeds.
Two individuals fall in love and marry against their parents' wishes. However, their life takes a dramatic turn when the woman is diagnosed with a life-threatening disease.
Believing his wife to be dead, Anand gives up his own child to Yashoda, who has lost her husband and her baby. However, he faces a dilemma when his wife returns.
Aditya finds himself on an island after surviving a shipwreck. Here, he realises he is a giant amongst its inhabitants, who think he is going to save them from a terrifying demon.
D K Malhotra leads a peaceful life with his wife and two daughters. But all of this changes when he is forced to bring a boy, who is his son from a previous relationship, home after his mother dies.

JD, an ambitious journalist known for integrity, spirals into addiction and scandal. Subsequently, his career and reputation crumble when he's accused of raping a colleague who works for him.
An aspiring screenwriter becomes involved in a diamond heist while writing a script for his film and struggles to evade the police.
Dushant, an aspiring singer, is encouraged by Jaya to achieve his dreams. However, after Dushant becomes successful, his other friends try to create misunderstandings between him and Jaya.
Sahibjaan, a young courtesan, falls in love with Salim. The two wish to marry, but the nature of her profession keeps casting a dark shadow over their plans.
Bhushan, a tax inspector, meets Ajit, a businessman evading an IT raid, on a cruise ship. In a bizarre turn of events, Ajit and Bhushan get lost on an isolated island.
Sam Bharucha, a police inspector, often comes across youth gangs creating nuisance in the city. When a young mobster is killed by him during a shootout, he embarks on a mission to find his family.
Aslam, a villager who runs a small business, accidentally meets the Prime Minister of India, who grants him special security on his request. Soon, he starts chasing political ambitions.
Kahani is in Goa waiting for her husband to arrive so that they can celebrate their first wedding anniversary together. Instead, the one who knocks at her door is a writer who pushes her buttons.
Inder and Pallavi fall for each other but her three possessive brothers hate him. Resultantly, the couple elopes, but they soon find themselves missing their families and decide to return.

A 42-year-old writer falls in love with a 22-year-old beauty queen. However, things get complicated when his roommate encourages him to make up stories to impress her.
Lovers Payal and Chetan elope as their families disapprove of their relationship. They start a new life working for Geeta, unaware of her true nature and affiliations.
Two siblings, Radha and Ramu, belong to a poor family. Their life takes an unexpected turn when a tragic incident leaves them orphaned.
In a village ruled by Madhukar and Jaggu, who deprive the people of education so they can easily oppress them, Ramu manages to educate himself secretly with the help of a school teacher.
Satpal Chauhan, a social worker from Haryana, works for women empowerment and also strives to create an alcohol-free society. However, while pursuing his goals, he faces several hardships.
Babu, who kills a man, is blackmailed by Bhagat into assuming the identity of a wealthy heir, Kundan, for his money. However, things get complicated when Babu falls in love with Kundan's sister.
Sita's sleepwalking turns out to be a cause of concern to her husband and family. When they investigate, they realize that her current behaviour is linked to her previous life.
Jai's father asks him to meet Sunita before getting married to her. However, complications arise when Jai falls in love with Kimi, while on his way to Sunita's village.
Arjun Pratap Singh, an IPS officer, strives to overcome multiple challenges and embarks on a mission to restore peace in society.
NRI Shyam comes to India to fulfil the final wish of his late mother who wanted him to marry an Indian girl. Unbeknownst to him, the girl he falls in love with is a pawn in the hands of his enemies.

Anishka, the daughter of a doctor, is kidnapped, and the abductors demand a hefty ransom. When Dr Viren abides by their rules and delivers the money, the kidnappers vanish with the money and Anishka.
After his boss, Jai Singh, commits suicide, Subhash, a chauffeur, conspires to get his insurance money. He then teams up with Jai's wife, Mallika, to make the suicide look like a well-planned murder.
When Anita commits suicide, Neeraj suspects foul play and decides to investigate the truth. However, things take a turn when he starts seeing Anita everywhere.
A rich girl runs away from home and settles down with a truck driver. However, her dream life is shattered when she learns that her new lover has been accused of murder.
The parents of an adopted child face issues of love, betrayal and custody when their daughter's birth mother arrives.
Shyam, a middle-class man, falls in love with a millionaire's daughter and marries her. However, as their relationship starts deteriorating, Shyam finds solace in the company of Radha.
Brothers Prem, Vijay and Ravi are happy, but their lives change when Prem gets killed. Ravi must save his family from an evil man, Dharampal, while Vijay is preoccupied with Sapna.
Geeta and her father undergo several hardships to ensure that Prakash gets an education abroad. However, things take a turn when, upon his return, he marries a rich girl.
Phullu's mother decides to marry him off to make him more mature. Things take an unexpected turn when he learns about menstruation after marriage.
A policeman sacrifices his life protecting Savitri and her twins from a gangster. Savitri raises the fallen officer's son as her twins, now separated, grow into a lawyer and a sniper.

Two brothers who excel in boxing are separated in childhood and take different paths after their father, a police officer, is murdered by a gangster.

After returning to his village, Ravi learns that the local farmers are being oppressed by a despotic landlord. Soon, he decides to contest the panchayat elections against the tyrant and put an end to his cruel rule.
A decorated school teacher's life is upended by devastating rumours, which ultimately lead to his death. His son Kundan now seeks vengeance.
Salman and Rukhsar's love brings two warring families face to face, only for tradition, dowry demands and heartbreak to test their fragile bond.
Raja, a young man, wants an easy life and marries for wealth and comfort. He soon finds out that there is an underlying secret of his wife and feels trapped.
A flood separates childhood friends Seema and Rajesh. Years later, when she reconciles with him and the two plan to get together, things go awry with the arrival of a mysterious woman.
With the Interpol on their trail, a group of international smugglers lose the shipments with all their treasures in a cyclone. A team is sent to salvage the sunken ship and scuttle the gang's plan.
Prem Mehra loses everything after one of his employees joins hands with his rapacious rival and the two plot against him. Later, his sons work together to retrieve their family's lost wealth.
Raju and Urmila fall deeply in love and vow to reunite in India. However, complications arise when Raju agrees to pose as Sharmila's husband before her family.
Born out of wedlock, Vijay grows up with deep resentment towards his biological father Raj, a wealthy industrialist who has been leading a comfortable life with his legitimate family in the big city.

Amar, a rich businessman, is framed by two undercover police officers, Seema and Jagmohan, for the murder of his uncle. To evade prison, he claims to be of unsound mind and tries to solve the mystery.
A policeman sacrifices his life protecting Savitri and her twins from a gangster. Savitri raises the fallen officer's son as her twins, now separated, grow into a lawyer and a sniper.

Joseph D'Souza frames Ghanshyam, an honest employee, for a murder, forcing him to flee from the police and to leave his family behind. Soon, things take a turn as he hatches a plan to destroy Ghanshyam's loved ones.
Pinky, the granddaughter of a wealthy industrialist, runs away and marries a taxi driver. However, the businessman holds Pinky's lover responsible and gets him arrested.
Rajkumari Ophelia hires a thug to steal an idol of Devi Maa that brings good luck to its owner. But the goddess soon begins unleashing her wrath, wreaking havoc in the lives of two noble families.
Tony, a burglar, comes under the radar of suspicion when a series of mysterious thefts bewilder the police. Soon enough, he tries to redeem his honour by going after the real criminal.
Two brothers struggle to keep their family together as external forces like the younger brother's father-in-law try to break them apart.
Pehlwaan, a criminal, narrowly escapes a police encounter and uses a holy man's guise to hide. Though he soon amasses many followers, he continues to carry out his illegal activities.
Jay, an expert in gambling, works for a criminal unaware that he is being used to gain military secrets. When the police discover this, they assign Inspector Vijay, Jay's lookalike, to stop him.
Twin brothers separated at birth become best friends, unaware of their bond as siblings. The queen, their mother, becomes the uniting force as they set out to defeat their evil uncle.

Inspector Samar is transferred to Motihari in Bihar, India, due to his honesty. He soon earns the wrath of a corrupt politician, Bachchu Yadav, who gradually becomes a threat to him and his family.
Vicky plans to marry Aarti, but his dreams are crushed when an incident causes her to lose her life. Fuelled by revenge, Vicky finds himself going down a dark path.
After landing multiple times in prison due to his hopeless nature, Raju gets caught up with an infamous gangster and tries to escape him.

Scolded by his family for being a miser, wealthy industrialist Dhaniram loves money. However, his two sons, Ajay and Vijay, are manipulated by their wives and despise their father, looking for ways to entrap him. Soon, he gets into a clash with a tax officer and the officer's siblings devise an evil plot to plunder the businessman's fortune.
Falsely accused of murder, Raja becomes a target for Vijay, a police inspector and his lover's brother. In a bid to end his misery and catch the real culprit, Raja sets out on a mission.
Four unemployed youth make a plan to kidnap a gangster, Irfan Khan, in an attempt to win the ransom money. However, the powerful don has other plans.
Gita, a girl from a wealthy family, falls in love with an idealistic Avinash who has stern principles in life. However, his changed behaviour post marriage troubles her.
A slum-dwelling performer finds a new calling as a rising disco star. However, things take an unfortunate turn when an enemy from the past reappears in his life.
Raj is hired as a bodyguard for Komal, and the two grow closer to each other over time. However, things get complicated when he comes across Nihal, the man who molested his sister.
